def _mpls_packet(fi, hdr, pay, out):
    labels = fi["labels"]
    N = fi["N"]
    q = hdr[fi["q"]]
    ttl = hdr[fi["t"]]
    dpos = fi["dpos"]
    residue = bytes([hdr[i] for i in dpos])
    mid = residue + pay
    wire = out["wire"]
    emitted = 0
    t = ttl
    for i in range(N):
        if t <= 0:
            break
        word = (labels[i] << 12) | (q << 9) | 0x100 | t
        wire.append((_U32(word) + mid).hex())
        emitted += 1
        if i < N - 1:
            if t <= 1:
                break
            t -= 1
    out["byte_hops"] = sum(len(s) >> 1 for s in wire)
    if emitted == N:
        vec = bytearray(fi["base"])
        for j, i in enumerate(dpos):
            vec[i] = residue[j]
        vec[fi["q"]] = q
        vec[fi["t"]] = t
        out["delivered"] = (bytes(vec) + pay).hex()
    else:
        out["delivered"] = None
    return out


def _ip_packet(fi, hdr, pay, out, reason):
    N = fi["N"]
    off = fi["t"]
    ttl = hdr[off]
    body = bytearray(hdr)
    wire = out["wire"]
    emitted = 0
    t = ttl
    for i in range(N):
        if t <= 0:
            break
        body[off] = t
        wire.append((bytes(body) + pay).hex())
        emitted += 1
        if i < N - 1:
            if t <= 1:
                break
            t -= 1
    out["byte_hops"] = sum(len(s) >> 1 for s in wire)
    out["delivered"] = wire[-1] if emitted == N else None
    return out


def run_replay(R):
    caps = R["caps"]
    F = R["flows"]
    tables = dict((n, {}) for n in caps)
    enabled = set()
    results = []
    for ev in R["events"]:
        op = ev[0]
        if op == "packet":
            _, fid, hdr, pay = ev
            fi = F[fid]
            out = {"mode": None, "reason": None, "wire": [],
                   "delivered": None, "byte_hops": 0}
            if fid not in enabled:
                out["mode"], out["reason"] = "ip", "disabled"
                _ip_packet(fi, hdr, pay, out, None)
            else:
                bad = False
                tmpl = fi["tmpl"]
                for i in fi["kpos"]:
                    if hdr[i] != tmpl[i]:
                        bad = True
                        break
                if bad:
                    out["mode"], out["reason"] = "ip", "mismatch"
                    _ip_packet(fi, hdr, pay, out, None)
                elif hdr[fi["q"]] > 7:
                    out["mode"], out["reason"] = "ip", "qos"
                    _ip_packet(fi, hdr, pay, out, None)
                else:
                    out["mode"], out["reason"] = "mpls", "compressed"
                    _mpls_packet(fi, hdr, pay, out)
            results.append(out)
        elif op == "put":
            _, fid, node = ev
            fi = F[fid]
            tb = tables[node]
            label = fi["labels"][fi["pidx"][node]]
            cur = tb.get(label)
            if cur == fid:
                st = "ok"
            elif cur is not None and cur in enabled:
                st = "busy"
            elif label not in tb and len(tb) >= caps[node]:
                st = "full"
            else:
                tb[label] = fid
                st = "ok"
            results.append({"status": st})
        elif op == "enable":
            fid = ev[1]
            if fid in enabled:
                results.append({"status": "ok"})
                continue
            fi = F[fid]
            ready = True
            for i, node in enumerate(fi["path"]):
                if tables[node].get(fi["labels"][i]) != fid:
                    ready = False
                    break
            if ready:
                enabled.add(fid)
                results.append({"status": "ok"})
            else:
                results.append({"status": "unready"})
        elif op == "disable":
            enabled.discard(ev[1])
            results.append({"status": "ok"})
        else:  # reset
            enabled.clear()
            results.append({"status": "ok"})
    tables_out = []
    for node in sorted(tables):
        tb = tables[node]
        for label in sorted(tb):
            tables_out.append({"node": node, "label": label,
                               "flow": tb[label]})
    return {"results": results, "active": sorted(enabled),
            "tables": tables_out}
